Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing port districts to provide consulting services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to port districts; and adding a new section tochapter 53.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 53.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A port district may receive compensation for consulting services itprovides on matters within the scope of this title or Title 14 RCW.
